description: 08_緊急輸送道路情報(熊本県玉名市) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 玉名市. 玉名市の緊急輸送道路の情報です。 (令和2年4月現在) 3D都市モデル（Project PLATEAU）玉名市（2020年度） geospatial. jp/ckan/dataset/plateau-43206-tamana-shi-2020. Coverage: 玉名市. The portal files it under the publisher 玉名市. Its tags are PLATEAU, オープンデータ, 一般国道, 主要地方道, 国道208号. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2023-11-09 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
